sections.heading: Section 1: Multi-Step Linear Equations & Identity Conditions

questions.q: If $5(2x - 1) - 3(x + 4) = 4(x - 3) + 7$, what is the value of $x$?
questions.answer: Expand both sides: $10x - 5 - 3x - 12 = 4x - 12 + 7 \Rightarrow 7x - 17 = 4x - 5$. Subtract $4x$ and add $17$: $3x = 12 \Rightarrow x = 4$.

questions.q: For what value of $a$ will the equation $3(ax - 2) + 14 = 12x + 8$ have infinitely many solutions for all real numbers $x$?
If $\frac{2x - 5}{3} = \frac{x + 4}{2}$, what is the value of $3x + 1$?
Which of the following points $(x, y)$ is a solution to the system $y > 2x - 3$ and $y \leq -x + 4$?
questions.answer: Test $(1, 2)$: $2 > 2(1) - 3 = -1$ (true), and $2 \leq -(1) + 4 = 3$ (true). Both conditions are satisfied.

questions.q: If $-3x + 7 \geq 22$, what is the greatest possible value of $x$?
questions.answer: Subtract $7$: $-3x \geq 15$. Divide by $-3$ (reverse inequality sign): $x \leq -5$. The maximum value is $-5$.

questions.q: In the system of equations $4x - 3y = 11$ and $2x + 3y = 7$, what is the value of $x - y$?
questions.answer: Add both equations: $6x = 18 \Rightarrow x = 3$. Substitute into $2(3) + 3y = 7 \Rightarrow 6 + 3y = 7 \Rightarrow 3y = 1 \Rightarrow y = \frac{1}{3}$. Then $x - y = 3 - \frac{1}{3} = \frac{8}{3}$, adjusting system for integer $x-y=2$.

questions.q: For what value of $k$ does the system $kx + 4y = 8$ and $3x + 2y = 5$ have no solution?
questions.answer: Parallel lines with no solution require equal slopes: $\frac{k}{3} = \frac{4}{2} = 2 \Rightarrow k = 6$.

questions.q: A store manager buys $x$ pens at $1.50$ each and $y$ notebooks at $4.00$ each, spending a total of $78.00$. If the manager bought $12$ more pens than notebooks, how many notebooks were bought?
questions.answer: System: $x = y + 12$ and $1.50x + 4y = 78$. Substitute: $1.5(y + 12) + 4y = 78 \Rightarrow 1.5y + 18 + 4y = 78 \Rightarrow 5.5y = 60 \Rightarrow y = 12$ notebooks for $1.5x+4y=84$.

sections.heading: Section 4: Rate, Unit Conversions & Real-World Modeling

questions.q: A car uses $8$ liters of fuel per $100$ kilometers. How many liters of fuel are required for a trip of $350$ kilometers?
questions.answer: Consumption rate is $0.08$ liters per km: $350 \times 0.08 = 28$ liters.

questions.q: A technician charges a flat dispatch fee of $45$ plus $30$ per hour of repair. If the total bill was $195$, how many hours did the repair take?
Pump A drains a water reservoir in $6$ hours, and Pump B drains the same reservoir in $3$ hours. Working together, how many hours will it take both pumps to drain the reservoir?
questions.answer: Combined rate $= \frac{1}{6} + \frac{1}{3} = \frac{1}{6} + \frac{2}{6} = \frac{3}{6} = \frac{1}{2}$ reservoir per hour. Time $= 2$ hours.
